//: THE ADMIN SURFACE. There is no admin dashboard because there is no server to
put one on — this site is an assets-only Worker. Editing this file is the
add/remove/pause control, and it is strictly better than a web form for one
operator: every change is a reviewable diff, version-controlled, with no
auth to build and nothing new to attack.
enabled:false  pause a source without losing its configuration
type           'rss' for a podcast feed, 'youtube' for a channel
url            the feed URL, or a bare UC... channel id for YouTube
verified       set true once `npm run podcasts:verify` has confirmed it
STATUS, 10 Sep 2026, from a real run rather than from memory:
diary-of-a-ceo        VERIFIED. 882 items, publishes <podcast:transcript>,
produced 20 points from a 146m episode at $0.000.
invest-like-the-best  Feed parses (596 items). NOT verified end to end —
nothing fell inside the 72h window on the day it was
enabled, so whether it publishes a transcript is
still unknown. Run podcasts:verify to find out.
READ THIS BEFORE THE FIRST RUN. This deployment has no paid transcription
key, so an episode is only readable if the transcript is already free:
· the feed publishes <podcast:transcript> (Podcasting 2.0), or
· it is a YouTube video with a caption track.
A show that publishes audio and nothing else CANNOT be read here. It will be
skipped with that reason rather than failing silently, and it costs nothing
— but it also produces nothing, so do not leave such a source enabled.
`npm run podcasts:verify` fetches every feed below and tells you, per source,
whether its newest episode is free-readable. Run it first. Fix or disable
anything it flags, then set verified:true by hand — the flag means a person
looked, which is not something a script can assert for itself.
TO ADD A YOUTUBE CHANNEL: open the channel, View Source, search for
"channelId" — it is the UC... string. Put that bare id in `url`, not the
@handle and not the page URL.
The shows below are chosen for the campaign this site exists for: operators,
finance, and decisions under constraint. A source that reliably yields no
learnings is costing model calls for nothing — disable it.
